sourceRecord.sourceWikitext:
__NOTOC__
{{recipesummary|category=Recipes for dessert|servings=12–15 servings|time=90 minutes|difficulty=4
}}{{recipe}}

This '''banana roll''' consists of a thin banana cake, topped with cream cheese frosting and rolled into a log shape. It is similar to a jelly roll or a Swiss roll.

==Ingredients==

=== Cake ===
*[[Cookbook:Powdered Sugar|Powdered sugar]]
*¾ [[Cookbook:Cup|cup]] [[Cookbook:Flour|all-purpose flour]]
*½ [[Cookbook:Teaspoon|teaspoon]] [[Cookbook:Baking Powder|baking powder]]
*½ teaspoon [[Cookbook:Baking Soda|baking soda]]
*¼ teaspoon [[Cookbook:Salt|salt]]
*3 [[Cookbook:Egg|eggs]]
*1 cup white [[Cookbook:Granulated Sugar|granulated sugar]]
*⅔ cup mashed [[Cookbook:Banana|banana]] (2 medium bananas)
*1 teaspoon [[Cookbook:Vanilla|vanilla extract]]

=== Filling ===
*1 package (8 ounces) [[Cookbook:Cream Cheese|cream cheese]], softened
*1 cup powdered sugar, sifted
*6 [[Cookbook:Tablespoon|tablespoons]] [[Cookbook:Butter|butter]], softened
*½ teaspoon vanilla extract
*½ teaspoon [[Cookbook:Banana|banana]] [[Cookbook:Extract|extract]]
*¼ cup powdered sugar
== Procedure ==
# Preheat [[Cookbook:Oven|oven]] to [[Cookbook:Oven Temperatures|375°F (180°C)]].
# Grease a 15×10-[[Cookbook:Inch|inch]] jelly-roll pan; line with [[Cookbook:Parchment Paper|parchment paper]]. Grease and flour paper; set aside.
# Spread out a clean, thin dish towel on the work surface (make sure the towel is larger than your jelly roll pan); sprinkle liberally with powdered sugar (this can be done using a mesh strainer).
#In a small bowl, [[Cookbook:Whisk|whisk]] together flour, baking powder, and baking soda.
#In a large bowl combine eggs and sugar; beat until thickened. Add bananas and vanilla; beat until well mixed.
#Stir flour mixture into egg mixture.
#Spread batter evenly into prepared pan, easing it carefully to the corners with a [[Cookbook:Spatula|spatula]].
#Bake for 13–15 minutes or until center springs back when lightly touched.
#Immediately loosen cake from edges of pan; invert cake onto the prepared towel. Remove pan; carefully peel off paper.
#Roll up cake in towel while hot, starting with 10-[[Cookbook:Inch|inch]] side. Cool completely on wire rack, at least an hour.
#When cake is almost completely cooled, make the filling: [[Cookbook:Beat|beat]] cream cheese, powdered sugar, butter, and both extracts in small mixing bowl until smooth.
#When cake has cooled completely, unroll and spread with filling, then re-roll cake. Wrap rolled cake in plastic wrap then refrigerate at least 1 hour (but overnight is best).
#To serve, unwrap cake and place on a platter. Sprinkle with powdered sugar, and then cut into slices.

steps.text: Preheat oven to 375°F (180°C).
Grease a 15×10-inch jelly-roll pan; line with parchment paper. Grease and flour paper; set aside.
Spread out a clean, thin dish towel on the work surface (make sure the towel is larger than your jelly roll pan); sprinkle liberally with powdered sugar (this can be done using a mesh strainer).
In a small bowl, whisk together flour, baking powder, and baking soda.
In a large bowl combine eggs and sugar; beat until thickened. Add bananas and vanilla; beat until well mixed.
Stir flour mixture into egg mixture.
Spread batter evenly into prepared pan, easing it carefully to the corners with a spatula.
Bake for 13–15 minutes or until center springs back when lightly touched.
Immediately loosen cake from edges of pan; invert cake onto the prepared towel. Remove pan; carefully peel off paper.
Roll up cake in towel while hot, starting with 10-inch side. Cool completely on wire rack, at least an hour.
When cake is almost completely cooled, make the filling: beat cream cheese, powdered sugar, butter, and both extracts in small mixing bowl until smooth.
When cake has cooled completely, unroll and spread with filling, then re-roll cake. Wrap rolled cake in plastic wrap then refrigerate at least 1 hour (but overnight is best).
To serve, unwrap cake and place on a platter. Sprinkle with powdered sugar, and then cut into slices.
